copied: Draft copied. Send it yourself after reviewing.
reminderHint: Review this draft before sharing. Nothing is sent automatically.
reminderText: Hello {{name}}, your recorded balance at {{business}} is {{amount}}. Please let us know when you can pay. Thank you.
aliasesHint: Add the names your shop uses, including Hindi. Duplicate aliases will still require a product choice.
packHint: For example, 12 pieces in one box. Only enter a conversion you use in this shop.
immutableUnit: Unit cannot change once stock movement history exists.
productSaved: Product updated. Existing invoices retain their original prices.
dailyRate: Use Edit product to update today’s selling price.
resetHint: This removes transactions and restores fictional sample stock in your demo shops. Your language preference stays saved. Real shops are unaffected.
rulesHint: These answers are calculated from this shop’s saved records. No AI provider is connected.
salesQuestion: How much did I sell today?
noDues: No customers have an outstanding balance.
noLow: No products are at their low-stock level.
askHint: Choose a question to see current figures.
searchAliases: Search names, SKU, barcode or aliases…
signedPayments: Payments include refunds as negative amounts.
unavailable: The statement could not be generated. Please retry.
